title: fix(smtp,nntp): redact AUTH command lines before debug logging
description:
## Why
Security finding from aubi research: both SMTP (crates/smtp/src/session.rs) and NNTP reader (crates/reader/src/session/lifecycle.rs) emit a debug!() log of the raw command line BEFORE parsing. This means:
- SMTP: 'AUTH PLAIN <base64_payload>' is logged verbatim at DEBUG. The base64 payload encodes \0user\0password and is trivially reversible.
- NNTP: 'AUTHINFO PASS <password>' is logged verbatim at DEBUG, exposing plaintext password directly.

If DEBUG logging is enabled in production (e.g., for troubleshooting), credentials are written to logs.

## What needs to be done
In the pre-parse debug log line in each session file, redact AUTH/AUTHINFO lines:
- If the line starts with 'AUTH ' (SMTP) or 'AUTHINFO PASS ' (NNTP), replace the full line with a redacted placeholder before logging.
- Alternatively, only log the verb (first token), not the full line.

## References
- SMTP: crates/smtp/src/session.rs line ~240
- NNTP: crates/reader/src/session/lifecycle.rs line ~339
- Security review finding from stoa-526bc4c6 research (2026-04-30)
